input: Write a story (about 2,000 words) about a lighthouse keeper who receives a letter addressed to someone who died a century ago.
Write a story (about 2,000 words) in which two rival bakers in a small town are forced to share one oven for a week.
Write a story (about 2,000 words) about a child who discovers that the family's old radio picks up conversations from tomorrow.
Write a story (about 2,000 words) about a cartographer asked to map a valley that changes shape every night.
Write a story (about 2,000 words) about an elderly chess champion who agrees to one last game against a stranger at a train station.
Write a story (about 2,000 words) about a translator who realises the treaty she is translating contains a hidden message meant for her.
Write a story (about 2,000 words) about a beekeeper whose bees begin building their comb in the shape of letters.
Write a story (about 2,000 words) about the last two crew members of a research ship stuck in Antarctic ice who disagree about whether to wait or walk.
Write a story (about 2,000 words) about a museum guard who notices that one painting's subject has changed position overnight.
Write a story (about 2,000 words) about a street musician who can only play songs that have never been written yet.
